description: Dispatcher-based analytical and visualization suite for chemical physics: eOn NEB/min/saddle plots, surfaces, geometry, ORCA helpers, and a Click CLI. Sibling of chemparseplot and pychum.
rules: Import the public surface from rgpycrumbs (see docs public API). Do not reach into private _modules.
CLI entry is rgpycrumbs. Sibling packages: chemparseplot (parse/plot) and pychum (input generation).
Prefer the documented Click commands under tools/eon, tools/geom, tools/orca, tools/surfaces.
Docs live at https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/ . Org source is under docs/orgmode/.
